build_cross_validation_training: build a cross-validation training script that trains BERT on GLUE MRPC using StratifiedKFold folds with Accelerate
create_fold_dataloaders: create fold dataloaders by selecting train and validation indices from a dataset and tokenizing with a BERT tokenizer
run_stratified_kfold_split: run stratified k-fold cross-validation splits on a dataset by label distribution with configurable number of folds
test_accelerator_training_loop: test the accelerator training loop with gradient accumulation, learning rate scheduling, and metric gathering across multiple folds
summarize_cli_arguments: summarize the CLI arguments including mixed precision mode, CPU flag, and number of k-fold splits for the training script
